name: fieldkit-admin-mcp
description: Local FieldKit companion for Speckle administration and data investigation. Separate from the official Speckle MCP.
long_description: Talks directly to one Speckle Server's GraphQL API using a personal access token. Covers the workspace -> projects -> models/versions -> content hierarchy: workspace/project/user administration, real usage signals (get_workspace_activity, get_contribution_rollup, get_project_team), dashboards and data-validation checks (list_project_insights, get_insight_results), per-version model-data analytics against the same EAV/packfile datasets Speckle's own AI feature uses, and support-case file intake (create_support_project, upload_file_to_project, get_file_import_status) — upload a customer's native Revit/Rhino/IFC/etc file straight into a dedicated project via Speckle's server-side importer, no connector or CAD license needed. Write tools (role changes, deletion, server config, support project/upload) are off by default behind SPECKLE_ADMIN_ALLOW_WRITES.

server_url.title: Speckle Server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the Speckle Server to administer, e.g. https://app.speckle.systems (no trailing slash).

token.title: Personal Access Token
token.description: PAT from Profile -> Settings -> Developer settings -> Personal access tokens. Needs profile:read, users:read, users:invite, server:setup scopes (add streams:write too for support-case file intake).

allow_writes.title: Allow write operations
allow_writes.description: Set to "true" to enable mutation tools (role changes, user deletion, server config updates, invites). Leave as "false" for read-only.
